card.name: Words just before rarity or frequency of events
card.fires_on: Linking or reporting words right after an adverse event or condition, where the next words give how rare or how often it was (e.g. 'was reported in 0.6%', 'is rare').

modes.label: Reported in X%
modes.description: The word 'reported' or 'was' after a named adverse event, before an incidence figure.

modes.label: Before 'rare'
modes.description: A pronoun or verb after a condition, right before the word rare.
modes.example: or even meningitis, but<< this>> is rare.

modes.label: Severe event wording
modes.description: A word within a phrase about severe events, before frequency or grade details.
modes.example: Cases of severe acute cadmium poisoning<< are>> rare.

card.writes: It pushes the model away from words like rare, occurrence and frequent, which suggests it lowers the chance of those frequency words coming next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a sentence says how rare or how common a side effect or condition was.
